id: title:Gilbert09:stop defaulting edition gated modules to sync

review.posthog_relevance: Adds compatibility and diagnostic capability to the Zoho CRM connector, preventing compatibility failures for users without the Inventory edition and preserving structured error details for debugging.
review.reason: The change removes unconditional syncing of Inventory-dependent modules, preventing compatibility failures for users lacking the Inventory edition. It also introduces a specific exception class and error preservation mechanism for Zoho API errors, allowing the connector to distinguish and retain module-specific diagnostic information rather than discarding generic HTTP errors. This
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit depends on the frequency of compatibility failures and the utility of the preserved error details, which are not established by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are indicated. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Removes unconditional sync of Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders, and adds should_sync_default=False to Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders.
observations.posthog_connection: These modules are edition-dependent; without explicit opt-in, an org missing the Inventory edition would fail on first sync. This preserves compatibility and avoids unnecessary failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class ZohoCRMApiError and a helper _with_zoho_error_detail to preserve Zoho's structured error body.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing an INVALID_MODULE error from other 400s, preserving the module-specific detail for better diagnostics.

observations.behavior: Wraps client.get() in readable_field_names and _fetch_page with try/except to propagate structured Zoho errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the structured error detail when fetching fields or records, rather than discarding the body and losing the module-specific cause.
